cause: The training pipeline applied log1p (natural log of 1 + x) to the raw feature value before storing it, while the serving pipeline used the raw value directly. Concretely: t_f4 = log1p(raw_x), s_f4 = raw_x = expm1(t_f4). The per-entity differences |s_f4 - expm1(t_f4)| are on the order of 1e-7 (floating-point noise), confirming an exact log1p/expm1 relationship. All other features (f1, f2, f3, f5) are identical between training and serving for matched entities.
